allow_ref_change.description: AllowRefChange permits resolvedReference changes during upgrade

allow_signer_change.description:
AllowSignerChange permits upgrading to an artifact signed by a
different identity than the recorded one

clients.description:
Clients lists target client identifiers. Empty means every
skill-supporting client detected on this host.

fail_on_changes.description: FailOnChanges reports content and trust changes without applying them

names.description: Names restricts the upgrade to specific skill names. Empty means every entry.

preview.description: Preview reports what would change without installing (still fetches to compare digests)

project_root.description: ProjectRoot is the project root path whose lock file should be upgraded

public_key.description: PublicKey proposes a cosign public key as the replacement trust anchor.
